lines: d14: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Jamal Ding is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d14: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d14: 🕯️ Jamal Ding is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d14: What Jamal kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d14: "Jamal's gone." Carolina looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Jamal." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d14: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Theo blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Land (Level 1). Eat the landscape with your eyes first: green + water + sun means food grows here. Start where those three meet.
d14: 📖 LEARNED: The Forager’s Eye (Level 1). You walk slower and see more. Food was always there; now you notice it.
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d14: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d14: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d14: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Jamal Ding, 14 days. The mantle passes to Theo Liu.
d14: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Theo Liu, 34 — a community gardener. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm.
d14: The village's quarrel was with Jamal — and Jamal is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d14: At the grave, Carolina speaks for Theo — "Jamal trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d14: The fire knew Theo before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
